passive.name: aegis circuit

ten percent is the roster per-stack scale.); rank 3 cleanse[0] = "all-negative" (a full circuit makes the next petal guard also cleanse the ally; the vocabulary entry is all-negative.); rank 5 trigger = "a barrier Circe granted absorbs damage" (each time a barrier Circe granted absorbs damage the circuit gains one charge (at most one per second); the behaviour vocabulary has no barrier-absorb condition, so the trigger is recorded here.); rank 5 maximumStacks = 4 (four charges, as the sheet shows (max 4).); rank 5 damagePercentPerStack = 15 (each charge adds damage to the next shard volley and is spent with it; dossier.identity: shield-wing operator who covers allies in petals of hardlight and charges a circuit with every blow they do not take~
dossier.selectionRationale: operator, chosen over the sheet's explorer label: explorer is not a role in this schema, and the kit is a ranged support loop (ally barriers, haste, a reflecting plate array and a charge circuit) rather than front-line holding, so operator is the nearest role. striker was rejected because the shard bolts are light, and bastion because Circe shields others, not herself. distinct from fable's healing and calyx's wall upkeep by converting absorbed damage into charges. hypothesis kit (owner decision 2026-11-07).
dossier.weaponConcept: rail rifle (long-range electromagnetic rail rifle for exploration, mapping and area control, non-lethal configuration: folding stock, magnetic-rail barrel assembly, terrain-analysis scope unit, removable power cell, phase-control receiver and folding crystal shield wing panels)

lore.backstory: a surveyor-cartographer who mapped the ruined districts for the relief guilds and learned that every route needs a shield at its edge. she folded the survey rifle into a rail weapon and its marker-wings into hardlight plates, and now walks ahead of whoever needs the way made safe~
lore.syndicateRecord: wanted for mapping three restricted sectors without a licence and for shielding a syndicate convoy from a rival that had not paid her a fee.
lore.psychProfile: curious, luminous and stubbornly kind; treats every unexplored street as a promise and every ally as the reason to keep walking.
lore.combatQuote: “more of this world is still beautiful than broken, darling. stay inside the petals and watch me prove it.”

iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Circe. Theme: aegis petals. Subject: a bold ring of overlapping petal wings around a single chunky circuit node. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
